title: 新聞自動販売ボックス
description: 歩道に立つ、ペデスタル付きの新聞販売ボックスです。光沢塗装の箱と傾斜した天板、前扉の枠と半透明の見本窓、引き手、硬貨投入部と返却ボタン、亜鉛めっきの支柱と台板を造形しています。新聞・紙名・価格表示などの文字は含まず、扉の開閉や販売機構は動作しません。 見本窓はGLB内の半透明（アルファブレンド）材質です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.520 × 1.069 × 0.470 m、1,076三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A pedestal-mounted newspaper vending box for sidewalks. It models the enamelled cabinet with sloped top, front door frame with a translucent display window, pull handle, coin mechanism with return button, and galvanized post and foot plate. Newspapers, titles, prices and other lettering are absent; the door and vending mechanism do not operate. The display window uses an alpha-blended GLB material. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.520 × 1.069 × 0.470 m; 1,076 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
